league_wrap.title: Camp Desk — Monday, Aug 17
league_wrap.bottom_line: Preseason Week 1 is in the books. Named starters and injury IR moves matter; exhibition scorelines do not. Thin camp info stays Pass.
storylines: Falcons: Penix still barred from 11-on-11 this week (Stefanski Monday). Availability fog continues — Pass on crowning Week 1.
Browns: Watson/Sanders mixed vs Chicago; Sanders starts Aug. 22 and both share ones in Bills joints. QB1 still unset.
Vikings: Murray remains named starter after a one-drive debut; McCarthy handled most of the first half vs Giants.
Commanders: Mariota right MCL — out rest of preseason; Quinn optimistic for regular season. Backup math thins.
Texans: Mertz season-ending ACL IR; Rypien signed as emergency QB3 behind Stroud/Mills.
Jets: Geno held (ankle precaution); Klubnik’s short starter sample aids QB2 case only. Hall groin is a usage flag.
Packers: Bullard boot off but still not practicing — slot/corner mix remains fluid.
League: rookies flashed (Bell, Lane, Slaughter, Garnes, Brown) — depth/usage notes, not win-total tickets.
league_wrap.what_to_watch: This week’s joints and second preseason scripts — especially CLE/BUF and ATL/IND — are evaluation tape, not market permission.

team_notes.title: Vikings camp — Aug 17
team_notes.bottom_line: Murray remains the named starter after a short preseason debut. Pass on inventing a new win-total lean from one series.
key_points: O’Connell named Murray starter Aug. 11; Saturday vs Giants he played the opening series (2-of-3, 10 yards) before McCarthy took most of the first half.
McCarthy is still the clear QB2 path in preseason scripts — not a buried prospect, not a dual-starter story.
Joint practices with Baltimore this week are the next meaningful eval window, not Saturday’s snap count alone.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Clean ones-only install vs Ravens joints; any change in McCarthy’s first-team share.
team_notes.sot_flag: Named QB1 still holds. Preview Bottom line must stop reading as an open battle.

team_notes.title: Falcons camp — Aug 17
team_notes.bottom_line: Penix still blocked from 11-on-11 this week. Week 1 starter lean stays Pass — availability, not a grass derby.
key_points: Stefanski said Monday Penix stays on the same ACL rehab plan: individuals, 7-on-7, no 11-on-11 this week (NBC / ESPN).

team_notes.sot_flag: Dual-QB availability unresolved. Do not crown Week 1 from rehab language.

team_notes.title: Commanders camp — Aug 17
team_notes.bottom_line: Mariota’s right MCL sprain ends his preseason. Daniels’ snaps and backup math are the story. Pass on manufacturing a lean.

Starter snap plan for remaining preseason may shift because the backup is gone — watch volume, not invented drama.

team_notes.sot_flag: Backup QB availability changed. Flag depth SoT; starter identity unchanged.

Houston signed Brett Rypien as the third arm for practice/preseason load.
Stroud remains QB1; Mills QB2. This is roster continuity insurance, not a KEI identity change.
